parameters.name: MessageEncoding
parameters.description:
The encoding method for the notification content. Valid values:

- PlainText: no encoding. The content is transmitted in plaintext.
- Base64: Base64 encoding.

Default value: Base64.

> This parameter can be set only for MNS Notification Recipient Settings.

parameters.name: NotificationArn
parameters.description:
The identity of the Notification Recipient. The following notification methods are supported when you configure the Settings for this parameter:

- CloudMonitor monitoring. The parameter value is in the format of `acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:cloudmonitor`.
- MNS queue. The parameter value is in the format of `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`.
- MNS topic. The parameter value is in the format of `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`.

The variables in the parameter format have the following meanings:
- region-id: the region ID of the scaling group.
- account-id: the Alibaba Cloud account ID.
- queuename: the name of the MNS queue.
- topicname: the name of the MNS topic.

parameters.name: NotificationType
parameters.description: One or more types of Auto Scaling event and resource change notifications. Valid values of N: 1 to 8.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the scaling group.

parameters.name: ScalingGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the scaling group.

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description:
The time zone for message notifications.
The offset relative to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), such as UTC+8 or UTC-7.
